subject.title: feat(browser): send pages to OpenClaw from the Chrome extension

question: Should OpenClaw ship page sharing as a bundled Chrome-extension capability with the proposed new extension permissions and public Plugin SDK session-resolution export?
rationale: The patch is an intentional new user-facing workflow and changes both the browser permission boundary and a shared SDK surface; correctness evidence alone cannot determine the desired permanent product/API boundary.

options.title: Sponsor and rebase the feature
options.body: Approve the bundled browser direction, rebase onto current main, and perform a final owner review of the permission and SDK contracts.

options.title: Narrow the ownership boundary
options.body: Keep page sharing browser-plugin-local by replacing the public SDK export with an existing approved seam or a deliberately reviewed generic plugin contract.

options.title: Defer bundled support
options.body: Pause the PR if page sharing should remain an external extension or plugin workflow rather than a bundled browser feature.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and rebase the feature
recommendation.body: Approve the bundled browser direction, rebase onto current main, and perform a final owner review of the permission and SDK contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied branch history identifies this person as the only evidenced owner of the proposed feature design; current-main ownership could not be independently traced.
